title: Spot the building block
instruction: Variable, condition or loop? Sort the pieces of code!

items.why: 0 is stored in the variable score.
The next part runs only when lives are 0. That's a condition.
It repeats while the game is running. That's a loop.
The variable name remembers the text Kuba.
The same step ten times in a row.

items.text: if it's raining → put your hood up
items.why: You put your hood up only when it's raining.
The variable changes: the new value is 1 less.
It goes through the numbers 0 to 99, one after another.
It lets you in only if the password matches.

debrief: A variable remembers something, a condition chooses what happens and a loop repeats. Almost every program is built from these three blocks.
